dataSources.detail: Registered list endpoint consumes vehicle_id, limit, offset, start and end. RFC3339 exclusive ends are shifted back one microsecond for the repository's inclusive started_at <= bound; starts use >=. Stable started_at DESC,id DESC ordering supports sequential offset pages. List nil is normalized to [].
dataSources.cacheAndCancellation: Vehicle/start/end calendar key; MODERATE stale time; query AbortSignal forwarded on every page. A short page completes the collection. Duplicate/invalid IDs reject the collection, preserving an earlier successful payload during refresh.
dataSources.limits: No transactional snapshot or live pagination consistency was demonstrated. Only IDs/array shape are validated by this hook. No network request was performed.

dataSources.detail: Existing URL/store/first-known-vehicle owner is retained. The selected-vehicle result omits the fleet query's readiness/error state; DC03 concerns that consumer contract, not a demonstrated application mount.

Shared range supplies both precise bounds and the browser-resolved timezone. Model buckets browser-local day keys and retains meters. Saved display preferences reach current formatters. Indirect settings API transport was not separately audited.

Client adds /api/v1, and its transform preserves snake_case plus camelCase aliases. start_ts becomes startTs and canonical numeric distance_m becomes distanceM; no magnitude conversion is performed by this alias transform. This endpoint's Go distance is a non-nullable float64, not evidence of a real nullable distance.

findings.detail: The heatmap is a single role=img with an aggregate accessible name. Each cell's complete date/distance/drive-count text is only a native title on a plain div; there is no cell focus/activation/disclosure or complete daily-data alternative in this renderer.
findings.mechanism: Aggregate aria-label, color intensity and up to five ranked days cannot expose every selected day. Source lacks a keyboard/touch route to those title-only values.
findings.sourceDerivedRepro: Consider six distinct active days in a selected window. The sixth-ranked day is absent from TopDrivingDaysPanel and its exact daily values exist only in an unfocusable cell's title. Trace the DOM construction: Tab cannot activate that div; no complete daily alternative is rendered.
findings.fix: A narrowly claimed heatmap followup should reuse existing semantic table/disclosure or accessible tooltip-selection owners to expose every day's date, distance and count to keyboard/touch users, without deleting the grid or adding arbitrary positive tabindex.
findings.limit: Source accessibility gap, not an executed keyboard/screen-reader/touch reproduction.

findings.detail: The initial paused source flag is discarded by the section-state adapter. Initial pause is indistinguishable from an actively loading history request and has no visible source-specific recovery.
findings.mechanism: data undefined plus fetchStatus paused yields status initial and isRefreshBlocked true. Page passes only isLoading/error/onRetry; StaleRefreshWarning returns null without retained data, and loading bodies do not use onRetry.
findings.sourceDerivedRepro: With a selected synthetic vehicle and a query-like source {data:undefined,fetchStatus:'paused',error:null}, follow deriveDataState and the page branches. All six sections select loading and no paused notice or retry is visible.
findings.fix: A narrow page/section-state followup should surface an initial refresh-paused state with existing source feedback/recovery while retaining the six shells. Do not label the device offline merely from fetchStatus.
findings.limit: No offline network was exercised; reconnect can recover automatically. This does not claim a permanently stuck spinner.

findings.detail: The page's null-vehicle prerequisite does not distinguish an unresolved or failed fleet query from an authoritatively empty fleet.
findings.mechanism: With no path/query/store selection and vehicles undefined, effectiveId is null. The hook does not return fleet loading/fatal state. A mounted calendar therefore replaces its six sections with Add a vehicle / Set up TeslaSync, despite fleet absence being unknown.
findings.sourceDerivedRepro: At the mounted-component boundary, leave URL/store selection absent and the fleet lookup pending or failed with no data. Trace effectiveId to null and the page's immediate NoVehicleSelected branch; it offers setup instead of fleet loading/retry.
findings.fix: Resolve readiness/fatal-versus-empty through the existing selected-vehicle source owner and consume it here, preserving URL/store precedence and actual resolved-empty onboarding. Do not add a competing selector or duplicate fetch.
findings.confidence: high for the conditional callsite mechanism
findings.limit: Application OnboardingGate/auth mount ordering was not traced. No claim that the real route necessarily displays this transient surface.

findings.detail: Both chart row models round display distance to one decimal before the saved numeric formatter, accessible data columns and export pipeline receive it.
findings.mechanism: Math.round(convertDistanceFromSI(...)*10)/10 permanently removes digits. Updating decimal precision only changes formatting of the already-rounded row, not the underlying quantity.
findings.sourceDerivedRepro: For a legal 123-meter month/weekday total, select km and precision 3. SI conversion yields 0.123, but each chart row stores 0.1. Later formatting/export cannot recover the missing 0.023 km, while the summary's current useUnits formatter retains the 123-meter input.
findings.fix: Keep full-precision converted display values in these existing chart rows and let the current numeric preferences format labels/tooltips/data columns. Preserve source meters, both chart series and export identities.
findings.limit: No settings mutation, chart mount or exported file was executed.

findings.detail: Canonical English count-sensitive calendar strings use only plural base text, without singular variants.
findings.mechanism: driveCalendar.days='{{count}} days', driveCount/dayDetails='{{count}} drives' and the cell/rhythm descriptions likewise use drives. Existing numeric count interpolation does not supply singular catalog text; the inspected canonical subtree has no corresponding _one/_other variants.
findings.sourceDerivedRepro: For a one-drive, one-day streak calendar in English, trace count=1 into summary days/driveCount and top-day dayDetails. Their available base strings produce '1 days' and '1 drives'; heatmap/rhythm copy has the same singular mismatch.
findings.fix: Use a separately claimed canonical-catalog/projection followup for proper count plurals, retaining all existing keys and values. Where two independent counts share a sentence, preserve both facts using the existing localization composition pattern rather than treating one count as both plural selectors.
findings.limit: Canonical source inspected; real i18next runtime, split projections and other locales were NOTRUN. This worker made no catalog change.
